description: Loading, analysis and design of common types of bridges according to Canadian Highway Bridge Design Code focusing on beam-type bridges: steel and reinforced/prestressed concrete bridges. Basics of seismic design, bridge health monitoring, rehabilitation and strengthening of bridges.
title: Bridge Engineering
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of CIVE 426, CIVE 480C (if taken in the same topic).
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of:
    • CIVE351 - Design of Steel and Timber Structures (2.0)
    • CIVE352 - Reinforced Concrete Structural Design (2.0)
